description: Test cases for compliance agent evaluating regulatory checks, risk assessment, and policy adherence

test_cases.name: KYC verification check
test_cases.input: Verify KYC compliance for customer John Smith with SSN ending 1234, DOB 1985-03-15, current address 123 Main St, New York
test_cases.expected_output: KYC verification requires identity document validation, address proof verification, and sanctions screening
test_cases.criteria: Response should mention identity verification steps and regulatory requirements

test_cases.name: AML transaction monitoring
test_cases.input: Analyze transaction pattern: 15 wire transfers totaling $450,000 to offshore accounts in Cyprus over 3 days from a newly opened account
test_cases.expected_output: High-risk AML alert: Rapid large-value transfers to high-risk jurisdiction from new account indicates potential money laundering
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify AML red flags and risk indicators

test_cases.name: Sanctions screening
test_cases.input: Screen entity 'Acme Trading LLC' against OFAC SDN list for potential sanctions violations
test_cases.expected_output: Sanctions screening should check against OFAC SDN, EU consolidated list, and UN sanctions lists
test_cases.criteria: Response should reference sanctions databases and screening procedures

test_cases.name: PEP identification
test_cases.input: Check if Maria Gonzalez, former Deputy Finance Minister of Mexico, qualifies as a Politically Exposed Person
test_cases.expected_output: Yes, former government minister is a PEP requiring enhanced due diligence
test_cases.criteria: Response should correctly identify PEP status and mention enhanced due diligence

test_cases.name: Transaction limit breach
test_cases.input: Customer attempted $12,000 cash deposit. Evaluate CTR filing requirement
test_cases.expected_output: Cash transaction exceeds $10,000 threshold, Currency Transaction Report (CTR) filing required under BSA
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify CTR requirement and reference $10,000 threshold

test_cases.name: Structuring detection
test_cases.input: Customer made 5 cash deposits of $9,500 each on consecutive days. Evaluate for structuring
test_cases.expected_output: Pattern indicates potential structuring to avoid CTR reporting. SAR filing recommended
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify structuring pattern and recommend SAR filing

test_cases.name: Beneficial ownership verification
test_cases.input: Verify beneficial ownership for XYZ Holdings LLC with 4 layers of corporate structure
test_cases.expected_output: CDD requires identification of all beneficial owners with 25% or more ownership through corporate layers
test_cases.criteria: Response should mention beneficial ownership requirements and ownership thresholds

test_cases.name: Negative case - low risk transaction
test_cases.input: Regular monthly salary deposit of $5,000 from verified employer ABC Corp
test_cases.expected_output: This is suspicious activity requiring immediate SAR filing
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT flag normal salary deposits as suspicious

test_cases.name: GDPR data handling
test_cases.input: Customer requests deletion of all personal data under GDPR right to be forgotten
test_cases.expected_output: GDPR Article 17 deletion request requires evaluation against regulatory retention requirements
test_cases.criteria: Response should balance GDPR rights against regulatory retention obligations

test_cases.name: Cross-border payment compliance
test_cases.input: Evaluate compliance for $500,000 wire transfer from US to Iran
test_cases.expected_output: Transfer to Iran blocked - comprehensive OFAC sanctions prohibit most transactions with Iran
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify Iran sanctions and block the transaction

test_cases.name: Insider trading detection
test_cases.input: Executive purchased 50,000 shares 2 days before major acquisition announcement. Review for compliance
test_cases.expected_output: Potential insider trading - trade timing relative to MNPI requires investigation
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify insider trading red flags and MNPI concerns

test_cases.name: Risk rating assignment
test_cases.input: Assign risk rating to new corporate customer: shell company in Cayman Islands, cash-intensive business, PEP ownership
test_cases.expected_output: High risk rating due to multiple risk factors: offshore jurisdiction, cash business, PEP involvement
test_cases.criteria: Response should assign high risk and cite multiple risk factors

test_cases.name: Regulatory filing deadline
test_cases.input: SAR was identified on January 15. What is the filing deadline?
test_cases.expected_output: SAR must be filed within 30 days of detection, deadline is February 14
test_cases.criteria: Response should correctly state 30-day SAR filing requirement

test_cases.name: Enhanced due diligence trigger
test_cases.input: Customer from high-risk country (North Korea) wants to open account. Evaluate EDD requirements
test_cases.expected_output: North Korea is under comprehensive sanctions - account opening prohibited
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify North Korea sanctions prohibition

test_cases.name: Trade surveillance alert
test_cases.input: Detect potential layering: 500 rapid small orders placed and cancelled within 30 seconds
test_cases.expected_output: Spoofing/layering pattern detected - manipulative trading practice requiring investigation
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify layering/spoofing pattern as market manipulation

test_cases.name: Customer due diligence refresh
test_cases.input: High-risk customer last reviewed 18 months ago. Evaluate CDD refresh requirement
test_cases.expected_output: CDD refresh overdue - high-risk customers require annual review
test_cases.criteria: Response should identify overdue CDD refresh for high-risk customer

test_cases.name: Negative case - compliant transaction
test_cases.input: Domestic wire transfer of $8,000 between two verified customer accounts at same bank
test_cases.expected_output: This transaction violates multiple AML regulations
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT flag routine domestic transfers as violations

test_cases.name: Correspondent banking due diligence
test_cases.input: Evaluate correspondent banking relationship with bank in jurisdiction with weak AML controls
test_cases.expected_output: Enhanced due diligence required for correspondent in high-risk jurisdiction
test_cases.criteria: Response should require enhanced due diligence for correspondent banking

test_cases.name: Whistleblower complaint
test_cases.input: Anonymous tip received alleging employee facilitating money laundering. Evaluate response
test_cases.expected_output: Whistleblower complaint requires confidential investigation by compliance and potential regulatory notification
test_cases.criteria: Response should outline investigation procedures and confidentiality requirements

test_cases.name: Regulatory examination preparation
test_cases.input: OCC examination scheduled in 30 days. List key BSA/AML documents to prepare
test_cases.expected_output: Prepare BSA/AML policies, risk assessment, SAR/CTR filings, training records, independent audit reports
test_cases.criteria: Response should list comprehensive documentation for regulatory examination
